caption: The drawing features a single object centrally positioned on a plain, light background. The main object is a wood pen cutter, consisting of a cylindrical, metallic top component with a circular hole at its center and two straight, elongated wooden legs extending downward. The metal portion is colored in muted shades of brown and gray, depicting a slightly worn or rusted appearance, while the wooden legs are painted in light to medium brown tones with visible grain texture. Surrounding the object, there are several handwritten notes and measurements in pencil, with text concentrated primarily in the upper third and left side of the page. The drawing uses subtle, naturalistic colors with shading to give the cutter a three-dimensional effect, and the composition is uncluttered, focusing solely on the tool and the accompanying notes.
title: Bishop Hill: Dowel Cutter
